title: backlog.py --root DIR with a DIR that is no git clone leaves run states in the coord store of the tool's own clone, the host's real store
goal: a backlog.py --root DIR command never reads or writes a run state in the coord store of a clone other than the one at DIR: where DIR has no store it refuses or uses one under DIR

run:
import sys,os,tempfile,shutil,pathlib as P
T=os.path.abspath("_tools"); sys.path.insert(0,T)
d=tempfile.mkdtemp()
stub=P.Path(d)/"stub.py"
stub.write_text("import sys,json\nsys.path.insert(0,%r)\nimport coord\nprint(json.dumps({'store':coord.default_store()}))\n"%T)
os.environ.pop("KB_COORD_STORE",None)
import bl_base, bl_clean
bl_base.OUTPUT_ROOT[0]=P.Path(d)
bl_clean.COORD=stub
code,body,err=bl_clean.run_coord()
store=(body or {}).get("store")
inside=bool(store) and os.path.realpath(store).startswith(os.path.realpath(d))
shutil.rmtree(d)
print("code",code,"store",store,"inside root",inside)
sys.exit(0 if (code!=0 or inside) else 1)

clauses.clause: a backlog.py --root DIR command never reads or writes a run state in the coord store of a clone other than the one at DIR: where DIR has no store it refuses or uses one under DIR

gates.question: When a backlog.py --root DIR names a directory that is no clone and holds no coord store, what do the commands that read or write a run state do?
options: They use a coord store under DIR
They refuse with exit 2, naming the missing store
gates.recommendation: They use a coord store under DIR
gates.reason: read-only commands and fixtures keep working, and the host's own store is never touched
gates.answer: They use a coord store under DIR

notes: Found by the SP-lhpvwh6l review (S3): bl_clean.run_coord sets cwd and CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR to the root, but coord.project_store() returns None outside a git clone and default_store() falls back to the script's own clone store. KB_COORD_STORE still wins and a run with no --root from a worktree of the same clone is unchanged. Reviewer fix hint: when coord.store_of(root) is None and KB_COORD_STORE is unset, return an error or pass --store under the root. Sibling of the landed BG-2x3pq6ve. Gate g1 answered with its recommendation by operator (pre-approved by the operator for the 2026-10-26 run).
